system.abilityReq: Craft (Magitech) 4, Craft (Genesis) 4, or other Ability to permanently bind a servant
system.description:
The manse has a servant creature dedicated to protecting it and serving the hearthstone bearer. It could be just about anything: a clockwork automaton built using Craft (Magitech), a life form engineered using Craft (Genesis), an undead thing animated by necromancy, a bound demon of the First Circle, or some other enslaved unfortunate. Bound Servitor may be purchased multiple times.

A character who builds his own manse needs the Abilities or Charms to create or bind a servitor; a manse the character merely claimed could have anything. First Circle demons bound to the manse count as Bound Servitors, but Second Circle demons are Guardians (Power 3).

Other sorts of bound servitors can have game traits comparable to First Circle demons. A good way to design a bound servitor is to start with the Regular Troops/Rebels template (see Exalted, p. 279) and add a few Abilities, extra Attributes or supernatural powers. Since they are made to defend the manse (among other duties), servitors may have innate weaponry and natural bashing and lethal soak comparable to medium-weight armor.

A servitor may never change its Motivation to serve and protect, can't act against its Motivation of its own will, and treats any suggestion to knowingly act against its Motivation as an Unacceptable Order.
